title_zh: 约定请临床人员解释饮水记录和检查项目

scenario.label_zh: 约定请临床人员解释饮水记录和检查项目
scenario.goal_zh: 列明饮水记录单位与检查名称的疑问，并约定转交临床人员答复

context_zh: 虚构门诊角色练习。病例卡显示饮水记录和两项检查名称，但没有给出个体化饮水建议。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: My appointment sheet mentions a kidney test and a liver test. Are those two separate appointments?

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: I can see the names, but I can't explain the tests. I'll ask the clinical team to clarify that.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: There's also a page for my fluid intake. I've written down three mugs of water, but the box asks for liters.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Have you noted how much each mug holds?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: No. One mug definitely isn't a liter, and I don't want to guess what I've been drinking.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: I'll include that question as well: how to record your existing intake accurately. I'm not asking you to change how much you drink.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Thank you. Please ask about the two test names and how to fill in that page.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: I will. The clinical team will need to answer both questions.
